game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Pipeline: Chain one function's output into the next to push flint stones down a processing line.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Chain one function's output into the next to push flint stones down a processing line. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the pipeline value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about pipeline to power up the sled courier and open the larder door.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Function Pipeline
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how pipeline changes.
